# Third-Party Materials

Do not add a third-party artifact until its canonical source, author, license or written permission, required notices, exact use, and modifications are recorded in `../ATTRIBUTION.md`.

The `cyber_engineer/` directory contains the unmodified relegendable-keycap template package used by the deterministic SXSY-B122 legend generator. Its included instructions permit editing, remixing, and redistribution and request credit to `cyber_engineer` (`@Mates_ENGINEER`) for official distributions. See that directory's README and the root attribution register for exact hashes and treatment.
